name: The Inn

evidence.note: Summary: two-level venue with three bars, live music and DJs until 4 am; crowds sing and dance along with local bands.
Review summary says band shows draw a crowd that sings and dances along.
Krush lists many past shows at The Inn, Long Beach, confirming it as a regular band venue.

dancing.notes: This is a busy party bar where crowds sing and dance along with local cover bands and DJs. Expect a crowded, standing room on band nights.

description: A two-level bar and restaurant in Long Beach's West End with three bars, bar food, and live bands and DJs that run late into the night.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). 'LB' = Long Beach. Krush's Oct 3 5 pm show was not found on the band's or venue's calendar, but Krush plays The Inn often. Long Beach is a city in Nassau County.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Address, phone, hours and social links confirmed on the venue's own site; address and phone match Google Maps. Long Beach is a city in Nassau County. Site footer also lists a fax, (516) 432-2547 (not recorded). No public email on the site. The site's images are all event flyers and specials posters (text-heavy), plus Wix stock backgrounds, so no photos were recorded. Logo says 'Estd. LBNY 1950 - Restaurant, Bar, Live Music'. Current description kept (Google also calls it bi-level with live bands and DJs); the site's events page shows a ticketed concert (Nov 13) and themed DJ nights. No dance floor described on the site.
hours: Mon-Fri 4 PM-4 AM; Sat-Sun 12 PM-4 AM

logo.alt: The Inn logo: 'The Inn' in old-style lettering with red and white stripes, above 'Estd. LBNY 1950' and 'Restaurant, Bar, Live Music' in navy
